kaw.source: estimated: starting back-calculation anti-windup gain, to be requalified by the controller owner

kd.source: estimated: derivative-on-measurement gain chosen by the DR-21 software step-response sweep on this estimated plant; not measured on hardware

kff.source: estimated: setpoint-acceleration feed-forward on roll and pitch: about 1.0 times the estimated axis inertia, chosen by the DR-21 software step-response sweep; none on yaw, where it saturates the small yaw torque limit and failed the 240 Hz sample-rate screen; not measured on hardware

ki.source: estimated: integral gain chosen by the DR-21 software step-response sweep on this estimated plant; not measured on hardware

kp.source: estimated: rate-loop gain chosen by the DR-21 software step-response sweep on this estimated plant (docs/research/drone-racing/M1-M3-2026-11-11); not measured on hardware

sample_rate.source: estimated: the only admitted controller sample schedule (240 Hz outer tick)

setpoint_lpf.source: estimated: first-order setpoint low-pass ahead of the feed-forward derivative, below the 120 Hz Nyquist frequency

tau_limit.source: estimated: starting torque-request limit, to be requalified by the controller owner

throttle_rate.source: estimated: rate-throttle policy full-stick slew starting value

resistance.source: derived: (V - Omega/Kv)/I at the F50 100% row (manufacturer-reported); lumps motor, ESC and wiring loss at an assumed full bridge duty

derived_diagnostics.fit_method: k_T, k_Q: least squares through the origin of T and displayed Q against Omega^2 over both rows; R = (V - Omega/Kv)/I at the 100% row (lumps ESC and wiring loss); thrust = grams * 1e-3 * 9.80665

provenance.notes: Experimental product candidate built from estimates, borrowed lab-fixture values and vendor-reported static rows. Nothing in this file is measured by this project or validated against flight data. Regenerate with derive.py; never hand-edit.

references.f50_table: LiG Power F50 2150 KV / F5146 static table, https://www.ligpower.com/product/f50-5inch-racing-drone-motor.html, accessed 2026-11-11 as transcribed in FPV/03 section 6; page bytes and hash not yet captured (intake open)
references.f5146_spec: T-Motor F5146 specification, https://www.t-hobby.com/products/t-motor-f5146-drone-propeller, accessed 2026-11-11 as transcribed in FPV/03 section 6: 5.1 in nominal diameter, 4.6 in pitch, recommends motors below 2100 KV (conflicts with the 2150 KV pairing; unresolved)

max_speed.source: derived: no-load ceiling Kv * full-charge pack OCV * max command; the fitted rows only reach 3669.6 rad/s, above that the static law is extrapolated

rotor_drag.source: borrowed: rotor in-plane drag coefficient k_h from the lab fixture Plant.research_quad()

thrust_coefficient.source: derived: k_T, least-squares fit through the origin against Omega^2 over F50 rows 50% and 100% (sources.json motor_rows, manufacturer-reported); residuals in provenance.derived_diagnostics

torque_coefficient.source: derived: k_Q, least-squares fit through the origin against Omega^2 over F50 rows 50% and 100% (sources.json motor_rows, manufacturer-reported) of the displayed torque (0.01 N*m display step, about +-2.8% coefficient uncertainty)
